title: commend — surcharge

sentences.sentence: The paper was highly commended in the UK Press Awards.
sentences.translation: 该报获得了“英国新闻奖”的高度褒奖。

sentences.sentence: Ambition is the seedling of genius, through love labor hands, in the fertile soil will become the strong sun.
sentences.translation: 志向是天才的幼苗，经过热爱劳动的双手的培育，在肥沃土里将成为粗壮的太阳。

sentences.sentence: Your lecture, it is so rich and colorful, your every word is like a long drought seedling get moist, we are under your moist, towering trees.
sentences.translation: 您讲的课，是那样丰富多彩，您的每句话犹如久旱的树苗得到滋润，我们就是在您的滋润下，长成参天大树。

sentences.sentence: This process is as important as the watering and fertilizing the seedlings: without water and nourishment the seedling can never grow into a mature tree and yield any fruit.
sentences.translation: 这一过程同样重要，如浇灌和施肥：没有水和营养，幼苗永远不能长成一棵成熟的树，并产生任何果实。

sentences.sentence: Might I your scribe and your confessor be.
sentences.translation: 我可以你和你的忏悔神父是抄写员。

sentences.sentence: I stepped out of his office and was brought to a small window near the exit, behind which sat a scribe who I knew must be a prisoner.
sentences.translation: 我走出他的办公室，被带到监狱出口处的一个小窗户边。窗后坐着一个抄写员，我知道他肯定是个囚徒。

sentences.sentence: The use of mosquito lure female mosquitoes.
sentences.translation: 运用蚊子的趋光性引诱雌蚊。

sentences.sentence: Can I go to the theatre?"asked a mosquito to her mother. "Yes, but.
sentences.translation: “我可以去电影院吗？”一只蚊子问妈妈。“可以，但是要小心。

sentences.sentence: He crushes it, with one hydraulic hand, almost unconsciously, like someone swatting a mosquito.
sentences.translation: 他下意识地地用液压手将它拍个稀烂，就像拍死一只蚊子。

sentences.sentence: Kangaroos harbour a vast range of parasites.
sentences.translation: 袋鼠身上有各种各样的寄生虫。

sentences.translation: 化肥

维生素缺乏；维生素缺乏症

sentences.sentence: They did blood tests on him for signs of vitamin deficiency.
sentences.translation: 他们给他做了血检看是否有缺乏维生素的迹象。

sentences.sentence: She has a microwave, but uses it mainly for defrosting bread.
sentences.translation: 她有一台微波炉，但是主要用于解冻面包。

sentences.sentence: We can wash in the stream near the campsite.
sentences.translation: 我们可以在营地附近的小溪里洗澡。

sentences.sentence: The smell of the food might attract dangerous animals to our campsite.
sentences.translation: 食物的气味还可能会招引危险的动物到我们的营地来。

sentences.sentence: I showed up at the campsite one morning to find them loading their carts.
sentences.translation: 一天早晨，我在营地发现他们正往大篷车里搬家什。

phrases.translation: 婴儿配方；婴儿配方食品
婴幼儿配方奶粉；婴幼儿配方
递推公式；递归公式；循环公式

sentences.translation: 计算距离的公式

sentences.sentence: Sugar is represented by the simple formula CHO.
sentences.translation: 糖以简单的分子式CHO表示。

sentences.sentence: Just after the avalanche.
sentences.translation: 就在这雪崩后不久。

sentences.sentence: But what if the avalanche happened?
sentences.translation: 不过，要是发生雪崩怎么办呢？

sentences.sentence: If the value was much lower than one, on the other hand, the avalanche would soon die out.
sentences.translation: 另一方面，如果结果是一个比一小很多的数字，那么雪崩很快就会停止。

phrases.translation: 无可奉告；不予置评；无意见

sentences.sentence: So far, Mr. Cook has not commented on these reports.
sentences.translation: 到目前为止，库克先生还未对这些报告进行过评论。

sentences.sentence: Give me your money and passbook.
sentences.translation: 把您的钱和存折给我。

sentences.sentence: I lost my passbook.
sentences.translation: 我把存折弄丢了。

sentences.sentence: Bank Clerk: Here are your card and passbook. Please bring either one when you deposit or draw money. Keep them well and inform us if you lose them.
sentences.translation: 银行职员：这是您的卡和存折，存取款时请带来。保管好存折，如有遗失请及时告诉我们。

sentences.sentence: ...a reformed alcoholic extolling the joys of temperance.
sentences.translation: ...一个已戒掉酒瘾的人对戒酒的好处赞不绝口。

sentences.sentence: The players wore black armbands as a tribute to their late teammate.
sentences.translation: 球员们戴着黑纱悼念已故的队友。

sentences.sentence: I’d like to pay tribute to (= praise and admire publicly ) the party workers for all their hard work.
sentences.translation: 我谨向党内工作人员致敬，感谢他们的辛苦努力。

sentences.sentence: Smoking during pregnancy endangers your baby’s life.
sentences.translation: 孕期吸烟会危及胎儿生命。

sentences.translation: 我所有的问题都是酗酒引起的。

sentences.translation: 去年的狂喜过后出现了普遍的悲观气氛。

text:
英语词汇 · GMAT · 第 231 单元

commend
音标：英 /kə'mend/  美 /kə'mɛnd/
v.  推荐； 表扬
短语：highly commended — 高度赞赏；受到好评的
短语：commend me to — ◎请代我问候…，请代我向…致意
例句：The paper was highly commended in the UK Press Awards.
该报获得了“英国新闻奖”的高度褒奖。

seedling
音标：英 /'siːdlɪŋ/  美 /'sidlɪŋ/
n.  幼苗； 树苗
短语：seedling stage — 苗期
短语：seedling nursery — 苗圃；播种苗圃
例句：Ambition is the seedling of genius, through love labor hands, in the fertile soil will become the strong sun.
志向是天才的幼苗，经过热爱劳动的双手的培育，在肥沃土里将成为粗壮的太阳。
例句：Your lecture, it is so rich and colorful, your every word is like a long drought seedling get moist, we are under your moist, towering trees.
您讲的课，是那样丰富多彩，您的每句话犹如久旱的树苗得到滋润，我们就是在您的滋润下，长成参天大树。
例句：This process is as important as the watering and fertilizing the seedlings: without water and nourishment the seedling can never grow into a mature tree and yield any fruit.
这一过程同样重要，如浇灌和施肥：没有水和营养，幼苗永远不能长成一棵成熟的树，并产生任何果实。

scribe
音标：英 /skraɪb/  美 /skraɪb/
v.  抄写
n. 抄写员；
例句：Might I your scribe and your confessor be.
我可以你和你的忏悔神父是抄写员。
例句：I stepped out of his office and was brought to a small window near the exit, behind which sat a scribe who I knew must be a prisoner.
我走出他的办公室，被带到监狱出口处的一个小窗户边。窗后坐着一个抄写员，我知道他肯定是个囚徒。

mosquito
音标：英 /mə'skiːtou/  美 /məˈskiːtoʊ/
n.  蚊子
短语：mosquito net — n. 蚊帐
短语：mosquito killer — 蚊香器
例句：The use of mosquito lure female mosquitoes.
运用蚊子的趋光性引诱雌蚊。
例句：Can I go to the theatre?"asked a mosquito to her mother. "Yes, but.
“我可以去电影院吗？”一只蚊子问妈妈。“可以，但是要小心。
例句：He crushes it, with one hydraulic hand, almost unconsciously, like someone swatting a mosquito.
他下意识地地用液压手将它拍个稀烂，就像拍死一只蚊子。

parasite
音标：英 /'pærəsaɪt/  美 /'pærəsaɪt/
n.  寄生虫； 食客
例句：Kangaroos harbour a vast range of parasites.
袋鼠身上有各种各样的寄生虫。

artificial
音标：英 /ˌɑːrtɪ'fɪʃl/  美 /,ɑrtɪ'fɪʃl/
adj.  人工的， 人造的
短语：artificial intelligence — 人工智能
短语：artificial leather — 人造革
短语：artificial insemination — 人工受精
短语：artificial stone — 人造石
短语：artificial life — 人工生命；人造生命
短语：artificial heart — [医]人工心脏
短语：artificial light — 人造光
短语：artificial lake — 人工湖；水库；人工蓄水池
短语：artificial flower — 人造花
短语：artificial aging — 人工时效；人工老化；人工硬化
短语：artificial color — 人工色素
短语：artificial limb — n. 假肢
短语：artificial marble — 人造大理石
短语：artificial lift — 人工升举
短语：artificial person — [经]法人
短语：artificial silk — 人造丝
短语：artificial respiration — 人工呼吸；人工呼吸急救法
短语：artificial satellite — 人造卫星
短语：artificial turf — 人造草皮
短语：artificial lighting — [机]人工照明
例句：artificial flowers
假花
例句：artificial light
人造光
例句：artificial fertilizers
化肥

deficiency
音标：英 /dɪ'fɪʃnsi/  美 /dɪ'fɪʃənsi/
n.  缺陷； 不足
短语：iron deficiency — 缺铁；铁缺乏
短语：iron deficiency anemia — 缺铁性贫血
短语：mental deficiency — 心智缺陷；智力缺陷；精神不健全
短语：acquired immune deficiency syndrome — 艾滋病；获得性免疫缺陷综合症
短语：deficiency disease — 营养缺乏病
短语：oxygen deficiency — 缺氧
短语：nutrient deficiency — 营养不足；养分缺乏
短语：vitamin deficiency — 维生素缺乏；维生素缺乏症
短语：nutritional deficiency — 营养不良
例句：They did blood tests on him for signs of vitamin deficiency.
他们给他做了血检看是否有缺乏维生素的迹象。

urbanize
音标：英 /'ɜːrbənaɪz/  美 /'ə:bənaiz/
v.  使…都市化

defrost
音标：英 /ˌdiː'frɔːst/  美 /,di'frɔst/
v.  除霜； 解冻
例句：She has a microwave, but uses it mainly for defrosting bread.
她有一台微波炉，但是主要用于解冻面包。

campsite
音标：英 /'kæmpsaɪt/  美 /'kæmpsaɪt/
n.  营地
例句：We can wash in the stream near the campsite.
我们可以在营地附近的小溪里洗澡。
例句：The smell of the food might attract dangerous animals to our campsite.
食物的气味还可能会招引危险的动物到我们的营地来。
例句：I showed up at the campsite one morning to find them loading their carts.
一天早晨，我在营地发现他们正往大篷车里搬家什。

formula
音标：英 /'fɔːrmjələ/  美 /'fɔrmjələ/
n.  公式
短语：empirical formula — 经验式；实验式
短语：infant formula — 婴儿配方；婴儿配方食品
短语：formula one — 一级方程式赛车
短语：general formula — 通式；一般公式
短语：mathematical formula — 数学公式
短语：computational formula — 计算公式
短语：approximate formula — 近似公式；近真公式
短语：baby formula — 婴幼儿配方奶粉；婴幼儿配方
短语：recurrence formula — 递推公式；递归公式；循环公式
短语：molecular formula — n. 分子式
短语：chemical formula — 化学式
短语：structural formula — 结构式；分子式
短语：recursion formula — 递推公式；[数]递归公式
短语：rational formula — 有理公式
短语：taylor formula — n. 泰勒公式
短语：interpolation formula — [计]插值公式
短语：euler's formula — 欧拉公式
短语：check formula — 验算公式
短语：asymptotic formula — [数]渐近公式
短语：exact formula — 精密公式
例句：the formula for calculating distance
计算距离的公式
例句：Sugar is represented by the simple formula CHO.
糖以简单的分子式CHO表示。

avalanche
音标：英 /'ævəlæntʃ/  美 /'ævəlæntʃ/
v.  雪崩
n. 雪崩；
短语：avalanche photodiode — 雪崩光电二极管
例句：Just after the avalanche.
就在这雪崩后不久。
例句：But what if the avalanche happened?
不过，要是发生雪崩怎么办呢？
例句：If the value was much lower than one, on the other hand, the avalanche would soon die out.
另一方面，如果结果是一个比一小很多的数字，那么雪崩很快就会停止。

comment
音标：英 /'kɑːment/  美 /'kɑmɛnt/
v.  发表评论
n. 评论，意见；
短语：comment on — 对……评论
短语：no comment — 无可奉告；不予置评；无意见
短语：general comment — 一般评论
短语：fair comment — 公正批评；公平评论
例句：So far, Mr. Cook has not commented on these reports.
到目前为止，库克先生还未对这些报告进行过评论。

passbook
音标：英 /'pæsbuk/  美 /'pæs'bʊk/
n.  存折
例句：Give me your money and passbook.
把您的钱和存折给我。
例句：I lost my passbook.
我把存折弄丢了。
例句：Bank Clerk: Here are your card and passbook. Please bring either one when you deposit or draw money. Keep them well and inform us if you lose them.
银行职员：这是您的卡和存折，存取款时请带来。保管好存折，如有遗失请及时告诉我们。

temperance
音标：英 /'tempərəns/  美 /'tɛmpərəns/
n.  节欲； 禁酒
例句：...a reformed alcoholic extolling the joys of temperance.
...一个已戒掉酒瘾的人对戒酒的好处赞不绝口。

tribute
音标：英 /'trɪbjuːt/  美 /'trɪbjut/
n.  礼物， 贡品
短语：pay tribute — 致敬；朝贡
例句：The players wore black armbands as a tribute to their late teammate.
球员们戴着黑纱悼念已故的队友。
例句：I’d like to pay tribute to (= praise and admire publicly ) the party workers for all their hard work.
我谨向党内工作人员致敬，感谢他们的辛苦努力。

endanger
音标：英 /ɪn'deɪndʒər/  美 /ɪn'dendʒɚ/
v.  危及， 危害
例句：Smoking during pregnancy endangers your baby’s life.
孕期吸烟会危及胎儿生命。

stem
音标：英 /stem/  美 /stɛm/
v.  起源于； 阻断
n. 茎，干；
短语：stem cell — 干细胞，骨髓干细胞
短语：stem from — 起源于
短语：brain stem — 脑干
短语：drill stem — 钻柱；钻杆；钻具
短语：main stem — [美俚]干线；主街
短语：valve stem — 【机】阀杆
短语：from stem to stern — 完全；从头到尾
短语：stem rust — 杆锈；茎锈病
短语：hemopoietic stem cell — 造血干细胞
短语：stem borer — 蛀茎虫；天牛；蔗螟；茶天牛
短语：rising stem — 升杆
短语：stem seal — 阀杆密封；芯轴密封
例句：All my problems stem from drink.
我所有的问题都是酗酒引起的。

euphoria
音标：英 /juː'fɔːriə/  美 /jʊ'fɔrɪə/
n.  精神欢快； 兴奋
例句：There was a general atmosphere of pessimism after the euphoria of last year.
去年的狂喜过后出现了普遍的悲观气氛。

surcharge
音标：英 /'sɜːrtʃɑːrdʒ/  美 /'sɝtʃɑrdʒ/
n.  附加税； 额外费
短语：fuel surcharge — 燃油附加费；燃油费；燃油特别付加运赁
短语：surcharge preloading — 超载预压法
例句：The government introduced a 15% surcharge on imports.
政府推出了15%的进口附加费。
